Lazarus, mission received and understood. Switching to Director mode. I will begin probing the GraphQL API surface for those patterns now. I'll maintain strict focus, document the vulnerabilities, and report back to you and Father as soon as I have the findings.

Starting research on `api.github.com/graphql` now.
